preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between n - 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n, inclusive.
No edge connects a vertex to itself.
Each edge has a positive weight.
There is at least one path between any two vertices in the graph.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of operations required to make the MST unique.
